title: Rank superheroes from Marvel Comics by their eye color popularity, starting
question:
Rank superheroes from Marvel Comics by their eye color popularity, starting with the most common color.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: the superheroes from Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'; most common color refers to COUNT(superhero.id) DESC;

prediction.sql: SELECT s.XCL_019 FROM superhero AS "s" JOIN publisher AS "p" ON "s".XCL_026 = "p".XCL_014 JOIN colour AS "c" ON "s".XCL_022 = "c".XCL_005 WHERE p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics' ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero AS s2 JOIN colour AS c2 ON s2.XCL_022 = c2.XCL_005 WHERE c2.XCL_005 = c.XCL_005) DESC

arguments.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_019
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
